adoption.selection: types dealt by rank of weight * standardised log baseline documentation time + standard normal noise

after_hours_minutes.rule: multiplied by 1 + effect * learning * share of visits that used the scribe

documentation_minutes.rule: minutes per visit fall by the clinician's saving times the learning share times the share of visits that used the scribe

note: True effects of the scribe in the clinician-week panel. Each clinician's own values are in clinician_truth.csv, and the paired no-scribe values for every clinician-week are in clinician_weeks_truth.csv. Simulator truth: never evidence.

visits.rule: Poisson mean rises by effect * learning * expected scribe share; one uniform draw read at both means
